_comment: Seeded schema profile so control-field resolution runs metric-aware offline (no ES). Mirrors the contract exercised by tests/test_metric_aware_label_resolution.py. 'fields' are the fields that exist in the target index; 'cooccurrence' lists [metric_field, candidate, co_occurs] triples the COUNT probe would return. The 'instance' control (label_values(up, instance)) must resolve to service.instance.id because that is the field co-occurring with the scoped metric (issue #163 / ISSUE-006).
